Plot S3 method for service DQA summary

Source: R/plot.cd_utilization_dqa.R
plot.cd_utilization_dqa.Rd

Draws the service utilization data quality summary as a formatted table, with the indicators grouped by section and a column for each year. Completeness and outlier percentages are shaded green at or above the threshold stored with the summary, yellow from 70 up to the threshold and red below 70.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'cd_utilization_dqa'
plot(x, years = NULL, title = NULL, width = NULL, ..., options = NULL)

Arguments

x

The score dataframe (needs class 'cd_utilization_dqa'), as returned by generate_service_dqa_summary().

years

Vector of years to display (e.g., 2020:2024). Required.

title

(Optional) Custom title for the table

width

(Optional) Total width in inches. If NULL, autofit is used.

...

Additional arguments

options

(Optional) A cd_chart_options() object: text, legend, fonts and sizes a user changed. Applied last, so it wins over the arguments above; the plot's own defaults are used for whatever it does not set. Any chart option can also be given by name in ....

Value

A flextable object (from the flextable package), not a ggplot. Chart options change ggplots only, so options has no effect on this table.

Examples

cache <- load_cache_data(system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core"))
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
#> ! The following columns are empty: anc_1trimester, under5_deaths, total_deaths,
#>   ipv2, measles_cases
#> ℹ Successfully loaded and cleaned data
#> ℹ Auto-detect candidates (|group|): vaccine=19, rmncah=28 -> selected rmncah
cache$adjust_data()
dqa <- cache$calculate_service_dqa_summary("national")

plot(dqa, years = cache$data_years)
